title: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Ameliorates Myocardial Fibrosis in Diabetic Mice Possibly by Modulating SIRT3 to Deacetylate GSK3β and Thereby Reducing the Phosphorylation of Smad3.

outcomes.name: cardiac function
outcomes.effect_text: significant alterations in cardiac structure and function; NMN effectively ameliorated these changes

outcomes.name: fibrosis-related protein expression (ac-GSK3β/GSK3β, p-Smad3/t-Smad3, α-SMA, Collagen I)
outcomes.effect_text: ac-GSK3β/GSK3β, p-Smad3/t-Smad3, α-SMA, and Collagen I were elevated; NMN effectively ameliorated these changes

outcomes.name: SIRT3 expression
outcomes.effect_text: SIRT3 expression was reduced; upregulating SIRT3 expression
